meeting_summary: Participant 1 and Carlos conducted an operational review of warehouse issues including congestion, inventory mismatches, scanner outages, and temp worker errors that caused delayed and incorrect shipments. They agreed on three immediate operational changes and a set of concrete action items, and identified an open strategic question about whether the current warehouse layout can sustain current volume, to be evaluated over the next seven days before a follow-up meeting Friday at 2 p.m.

key_topics.topic: Warehouse congestion in zones B and C
key_topics.summary: Overflow inventory placed too close to picking lines is causing forklift and picker traffic conflicts, slowing picking, delaying packing, and causing missed carrier cutoff times.

key_topics.topic: Scanner outages and manual entry errors
key_topics.summary: Three handheld scanners went offline Tuesday, forcing manual recording of item moves, which caused delayed inventory updates and system-to-floor discrepancies.
Two temp workers brought in last week had not fully learned scan confirmation and pallet labeling steps, likely contributing to labeling errors and incorrect pallet staging.
An informal handoff process led to a driver arriving to find a missing pallet and a misplaced pallet, resulting in a partial load and a customer receiving an order a day late.
System records and physical floor state are misaligned across several fast-moving SKUs, causing teams to waste time searching for product and outbound orders to get stuck.

key_topics.topic: Seasonal overstock and slotting plan failure
key_topics.summary: Last week's seasonal overstock was placed quickly without updating the slotting plan, causing staff to improvise storage locations and worsening congestion and visibility issues.

Three immediate changes were agreed upon: re-slotting overflow out of zones B and C, creating a pick-only lane during peak hours, and implementing a mandatory staging verification check before dispatch confirmation.

key_topics.topic: Targeted cycle count on affected SKUs
key_topics.summary: A targeted cycle count on high-volume mismatched SKUs was agreed upon, with a variance report due by end of day.

key_topics.topic: Strategic question: layout capacity vs. current volume
key_topics.summary: Both participants raised the open question of whether warehouse issues are temporary execution problems or a sign that the current layout can no longer support sustained inbound and outbound volume.

key_topics.topic: Seven-day measurement window and follow-up meeting
key_topics.summary: Agreed to use the next seven days to measure the impact of changes, then reconvene Friday at 2 p.m. to decide whether this is a short-term fix or the start of a larger layout redesign.

decisions.decision: Re-slot overflow inventory out of zones B and C immediately, starting today
decisions.context: Overflow inventory placed too close to picking lines is causing forklift-picker traffic conflicts and cascading delays

decisions.decision: Set up a pick-only lane during peak hours to prevent forklifts from blocking order selectors
decisions.context: Forklift and picker traffic sharing the same lanes is slowing picking and causing downstream packing and shipping delays

decisions.decision: Implement a mandatory staging verification check before dispatch confirmation, requiring pallet label, bay number, and scan time to all match
decisions.context: Informal handoff process led to a driver receiving a partial and misplaced load, causing a late customer delivery

decisions.decision: Temp workers must complete refresher training on scanning and labeling before returning to independent picking tasks
decisions.context: Temp workers unfamiliar with scan confirmation and pallet labeling steps are believed to be the source of labeling errors

decisions.decision: Run a targeted cycle count on high-volume SKUs showing mismatches, with a variance report due by end of day
decisions.context: System and floor inventory records are misaligned across fast-moving SKUs, creating dangerous visibility gaps

decisions.decision: Plan around shared scanner devices for the next day while repairs are completed
decisions.context: One replacement scanner available today, broken units expected repaired by tomorrow afternoon; sharing devices is the interim path forward

decisions.decision: Use the next seven days to measure the impact of the operational changes before deciding on a larger layout redesign
decisions.context: Open question exists about whether issues are execution-based or structural; data over seven days will inform that decision

decisions.decision: Reconvene Friday at 2 p.m. to review numbers and decide whether this is a short-term recovery or the start of a warehouse redesign
decisions.context: Follow-up needed to evaluate whether stabilization measures resolved the root cause or whether a structural layout change is required

decisions.context: New staging verification steps will add time; a short delay is preferable to another wrong shipment
